tools.name: list_trade_tools
tools.description: Find a tool among 100 BPJ trade workflows in compliance, customs, tax and refunds, FX and settlement, and shipping documents. Requires a BPJ trade MCP key. Returns paginated summaries.

tools.name: get_trade_tool
tools.description: Get the source, scope, exact input schema and worked example for a tool ID. Requires a BPJ trade MCP key. Use this before run_trade_tool.

tools.name: run_trade_tool
tools.description: Run one deterministic calculation or evidence checklist using its exact input schema. Requires a BPJ trade MCP key and uses one shared daily web/MCP run. Treat legal or policy results as aids for human review.
